title: Feature Locked - Customer Believes It's Included
agent_context: Customer on Starter plan can’t access Export, which is only available on Pro+. Acknowledge urgency, confirm entitlement, offer a quick workaround first, then present upgrade as an optional path.

raw_content.initial_message: Why is the Export button locked? I paid for this. It’s urgent and I need to export the report right now.
raw_content.context: Customer is on the 'Starter' plan. Export feature is included only in 'Pro' and above. Policy: do not blame customer; verify plan and explain clearly; offer workaround (share view-only link / copy data) and propose upgrade options without pressure. If customer claims they were promised Export, check notes and escalate if needed.

learning_objectives: Explain plan limitations without sounding defensive
Offer immediate workaround to reduce urgency
Position upgrade as an option, not pressure
correct_sop_steps: Confirm account and plan tier (Starter) and verify the feature entitlement
Explain calmly: Export is available on Pro+; avoid blame language
Offer immediate workaround (share link, copy table, screenshot, alternative output) based on use case
Offer upgrade path (trial/one-time upgrade/proration if available) and explain impact
If customer insists it was promised, offer to review prior notes and escalate to billing/CS lead
common_mistakes: Saying 'you should have known' or blaming the customer
Jumping to upsell without helping with workaround first
Using vague language instead of clear plan explanation
Refusing to check prior notes when customer claims they were promised the feature

must_demonstrate: Clear plan/entitlement explanation in soft language
At least one workable immediate alternative
Upgrade mentioned as an option (not pressure)
bonus_points: Asks one clarifying question about export use case
Offers to review account notes if customer claims they were promised Export
sticky_notes: KEY: Provide a workaround before talking upgrade.
TRAP: Don’t blame the customer for choosing the plan.
HINT: Ask what format they need the export in to propose a workaround.

customer_persona_hints.starting_tone: Urgent and slightly accusatory, but cooperative if helped quickly
customer_persona_hints.secret_acceptance_condition: Will calm down if you offer a workable alternative within 2 turns and explain entitlement clearly
